input-field.name: postsPerPage
input-field.label: Entries per page
每页文章数
input-field.helpText: How many entries one listing page shows. Values below 1 fall back to the default of 12.
列表页每页显示的文章数量。小于 1 的值会回落到默认的 12。

input-field.name: showAuthor
input-field.label: Show the author
显示作者
input-field.helpText: Shows the byline on the cards and the author card below an article.
在卡片上显示署名，并在文章末尾显示作者卡。

input-field.name: showReadingTime
input-field.label: Show the reading time
显示阅读时长
input-field.helpText: The estimate is computed from the body of the entry: latin words and chinese characters are counted separately.
阅读时长由正文估算，拉丁词与中文字符分别计数。

input-field.name: relatedPostsCount
input-field.label: Related entries below an article
文末相关文章数
input-field.helpText: Entries from the same categories are preferred, the block is topped up with the newest entries. 0 switches the block off.
优先取同分类的文章，不足时用最新文章补齐。填 0 表示关闭该区块。

input-field.name: tocEnabled
input-field.label: Table of contents
显示目录
input-field.helpText: The table of contents is built from the h2 and h3 headings of the body on the server, so it also works without javascript.
目录由正文里的 h2、h3 在服务端生成，不依赖 JavaScript 也能显示。

input-field.name: commentsEnabled
input-field.label: Comments below an article
文章评论
input-field.helpText: Switches the whole comment thread off: no thread, no form and the write route refuses new comments.
关闭后既不显示评论区也不显示表单，写入接口同样会拒绝新评论。

input-field.name: autoPublishComments
input-field.label: Show new comments without moderation
新评论免审核直接显示
input-field.helpText: Off by default. When off, every comment waits for a moderator in the administration before a visitor can read it.
默认关闭。关闭时每条评论都要在后台审核通过后访客才能看到。

input-field.name: commentsPerPage
input-field.label: Comments per page
每页评论数
input-field.helpText: How many top level comments one page of a thread shows. Replies travel with their parent and do not count against this number.
评论区每页显示的顶层评论数；回复跟随父评论一起显示，不占用这个数量。
